caption: The drawing features a single object: a stylized figure of a seated rabbit placed centrally on a plain off-white background. The rabbit is depicted with an off-white or cream-colored body, with darker shading used to outline its features and provide a sense of volume. Its ears are upright, with the insides colored pinkish-red. The eyes are large, mostly yellow with black pupils, and outlined in black, as are the eyebrows and the line running down from the nose area. The mouth is indicated with red and black lines. The rabbit wears a plain red collar around its neck. The tips of all four feet are painted black. The overall composition is simple, with the rabbit figure isolated and no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Chalkware Rabbit
